about_the_game:
Permanent Sleep: The dominant has come is a suspense, deduction, and romance-themed AVG game.

This game plays with a special mental jury mechanic. The goal is not to uncover the real truth, but to stand on your side and push backwards to defeat the opposing side, gain more spiritual followers, and win the trial's ultimate victory.

  • Dream Search

Travel through the dream realm where the sun and moon are divided.

Acquire evidence in the gap between spirit and reality.

  • Spirit Trial

A spiritual jury system.

More important than the truth is the will of the people.

Use the human and physical evidence in your hands to win the trial.

  • Reality Gaming

Cooperation, confrontation or betrayal.

The two protagonists are heading for different paths.

The future of the world will be determined by you as you fight for your beliefs.

  • Male and female protagonists

Male detective and female detective, totally different character and choice.

  • Dual Narrative

Dramatic changes in the situation, switching between different positions.

  • Retro-future style

Alternate between dream and reality, retro and avant-garde colors.

  • Different characters

Build bonds of love and hate with characters that transcend the constraints of tradition and reality.

short_description: This is an AVG game of deduction, suspense and love. The gameplay is a special spiritual jury system. Players will take the role of female detective or male police officer, traveling between dream and reality, and jointly investigate the years of unresolved “brunette female serial murder case”.
